strings.en:
A huge cryosleep facility under construction for Project Ark
(the species preservation plan) promoted by the
<EOT Special Council>.
Located underground in the Kenya district of Africa, it is
managed by Magus, an autonomous supercomputer
developed by Dr. Sophia Nate.
Thousands of people were to enter cryosleep there to
survive the coming war of invasion with the <Aerogators>, but
construction was halted when the <DC War> broke out.
After the war, it was seized by <DC> remnants and became
their base, but it was heavily damaged in battle with the
Kurogane team. It was then placed under the jurisdiction of a
special <Federation Army> research agency.
A similar facility, the "Moon Cradle," also exists on the Moon.

strings.en:
A dimensional fault deployed by the <Ruina> during
<The Sealing War> that enveloped the whole Earth. It cut
away the space around Earth and dropped it wholesale into
another dimension, severing the Earth itself from its
original dimension. As a result, Earth could no longer be
seen from space, and the sun, moon and stars vanished
from Earth's sky (a phenomenon later called the
"<Black Sky>"). Travel and communication between Earth
and space also became impossible.
The Ruina meant to plunge Earth into darkness, drive
people to despair, and swell their negative thoughts all at
once to bring about the advent of <Perfectio>. Thanks to
the <Steel Dragons>, the Atrum Exterior was not deployed
for long and has since vanished.

evolved from fighter planes.
The <Tesla Drive>, a high-efficiency reaction drive that

unaided, and their aerial agility surpasses any fighter's.
They were the <DC>'s main force during the <DC War>.
After the war, <Isurugi Heavy Industries> kept producing
them, and they now serve as the <Federation Army>'s main
weapons.

strings.en:
A lone island off the Marquesas Islands in the South
Pacific, where the mysterious meteorite <Meteor 3> fell in
<S.C.> 179.
The <EOTI Institute> set up its headquarters there to study
it, and the <EOT> and anti-alien weapon technology
researched there became the foundation of the <DC>'s
forces.
The entire island is fortified in the name of keeping EOT
secrets. Due to its geography, the fortress is built mainly
around air defense and air power.
Its facilities were nearly destroyed in the battle against
the Septuagint in the <L5 Campaign>, but the <Gaia Savers>
rebuilt it and made it their headquarters.

strings.en:
Near the end of the <DC War>, the <Earth Federation Army>'s
multipurpose battleship Hagane made full use of its
capabilities to break through to <Aidoneus Island>, the <DC>'s
headquarters. It meant to destroy the DC's core with its
bow-mounted Tronium Buster Cannon, but was blocked by
the DC flagship Kurogane, a Space Noah-class multipurpose
battleship like the Hagane. The Hagane then deployed its
mixed <PT> and <Super Robot> unit, whose valiant fighting put
the DC's <Armored Module> forces on the back foot. Finally,
the Valsion, piloted by DC leader <Bian Zoldark>, sortied and
clashed with the Hagane's mixed PT and Super Robot unit.
The Valsion was shot down, and Bian Zoldark was killed.

strings.en:
A bizarre group that appeared in the Earth Sphere from
<S.C.> 187 to 188.
Its main force was a group of mysterious bio-weapons
called the Einst Series, which at first repeatedly fought
baffling local battles. Only the high-ranking Einst called
Regisseurs and a girl named Alchemie had clear will,
intelligence and the ability to communicate; the group's
structure resembles that of bees or ants.
The Einst themselves have existed since ancient times in
another dimension (Einst Space) and seem to have
watched the actions of intelligent life in our world, but the
details are unknown. Their goal was to wipe out humans,
who keep fighting one another and disturb the stillness of
the universe, and create new intelligent life; in the end,
they tried to link Einst Space with our world and invade it.
The Einst fought the Hagane, Kurogane and Hiryu Custom
many times, and in the final battle the Neu Regisseur fused
with the <White Star>, becoming the colossal mobile weapon
Stern Neu Regisseur, but it was defeated by the Kurogane
and Hiryu Custom. After the Stern Neu Regisseur's
destruction, the Einst Series active around the world met
the same fate.

strings.en:
Short for Anti Sensor and Rader Sphere-field: an
anti-detection spherical field, or the device that
generates it. Pronounced "asres."
A kind of ECM used by <DC> remnants. It forms a special
spherical field (ASRS) of any radius around the emitter;
radar waves that hit it travel around the sphere and keep
going straight, so the receiving radar gets no reflected
waves at all. Its flaw is that it can only be used briefly, but
DC remnants have pulled off many surprise attacks on the
<Federation Army> with ASRS-equipped units.

strings.en:
The last enemy the <Steel Dragons> fought, inside the space
within the <Cross Gate> at the end of <The Sealing War>.
A new man-made god born when <Euzeth> Gozzo pieced
together fragments of false memories (something like
memories of past lives), and fused <AI1>, which had been
regenerated with "Z (Zfylud) Crystal," the <Aerogators>'
autonomous, self-aware metal cells, and had absorbed the
Cross Gate, with <Gan Eden>, which had been wrecked in
battle with the Steel Dragons.
The strong will of the artificial Masiaf (Ing) taken inside it
kept it stable, and he also served as the device that let it
control the power of not only Gan Eden but the Cross Gate
as well. It generated within itself the "Cross Gate
Paradigm System," a device that freely manipulates
causality through Akasha variable factors, and sought to
use that omnipotent power to destroy all parallel worlds,
then create a new world and become its new progenitor of
humanity.
But during the battle with the Steel Dragons, Ing was
ejected from within, and under their fierce assault it was
destroyed.

A high-level Federation government body that handles
secrets related to <Meteor 3> and the <Aerogators>, made
up of 13 core members of the Federal Security
Committee. It is also the parent body of the
<EOTI Institute>.
Its chairman was Carl Streissman, also vice-chairman of
the Federal Security Committee. Having learned of the
Aerogators' overwhelming might from studies of Meteor
3 and the <EOT>, they saw Bian, who called for all-out
resistance, as dangerous, and watched and obstructed
him. That in turn became one of the reasons Bian
resolved to raise the <DC>.
Carl Streissman and every other member died during the
<L5 Campaign>, and the council itself ceased to exist.

aerospace in particular and holds an important place in
the arms industry.
It once supplied the <Federation Army> with its main
fighter, the F-32 Schwert, while also having ties to the
<EOTI Institute>, and during the <DC War> it secretly
mass-produced the Lion Series.
Ironically, after the <L5 Campaign>, the series was
adopted as the Federation Army's main unit, and to
secure a stable production line, the company's aid to the

strings.en:
A group sent to the Earth Sphere by the <Zovorg>. Judging
that humanity, with its insatiable fighting spirit, would
eventually disrupt the order of the galaxy, they schemed to
bring the Earth Sphere under their rule.
The name Inspectors was a convenient label used by Vigagi,
their combat commander, during a battle with the Hiryu
Custom, and it simply became Earth's code name for them.
They began an armed invasion in <S.C.> 187, and in a blitz they
seized the <White Star>, the Moon and key parts of the North
American district.
However, caught up in the <Earth Federation Army>'s
counteroffensive "<Operation Plantagenet>" and the chaos
caused by the mass outbreak of the <Einst> Series, they were
forced to withdraw from Earth.
They then lost the decisive battle at the White Star with the
Kurogane and Hiryu Custom, and with supreme commander
Wendolo and other key members killed in action, the
Inspectors were wiped out.

The Inspectors were a group of aliens who came from
another star system and audited Earth's civilization.
Judging that humanity, with its insatiable fighting spirit,
would eventually disrupt the order of the galaxy, they
schemed to bring the Earth Sphere under their rule.
They began an armed invasion in S.C. 187, and in a blitz
seized the Moon and the North American district.
However, caught up in the chaos caused by the mass
outbreak of the <Einst> Series, they were forced to
withdraw from Earth, and were wiped out after losing the
decisive battle with the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom.

body. In the end it became part of the <Adamatron> and was

strings.en:
Humanity's first sealed space colony, completed in <S.C.>
075.
It houses the Colony Government and the headquarters of
the <United Colony Corps>.
The history of the space colonies up to the S.C. 180s was
a string of hardships: in 076, civil strife caused by failed
space-adaptation surgery on the first space emigrants; in
157, a major terrorist incident aimed at winning autonomy
(the Nozomi Incident); in 172, a colony bulkhead bombing
(the Hope Incident); and in 184, a terrorist attack with BC
weapons (the Elpis Incident). Each claimed many lives.
From the early 160s, however, a movement (NID4) arose
seeking autonomy from the <Earth Federation Government>
by peaceful means.
Its leader, Bryan Midcrid, won Earth's public opinion over
to his side, achieved colony independence in 184, and
became the first President of the Colony Government (at
the same time, the Earth Federation Space Force
stationed in the colonies was reorganized as the United
Colony Corps, with Maier as its supreme commander).
There are 10 space colonies: No. 1 Elpis, No. 2 Nozomi, No.
3 Hoffnung, No. 4 Wish, No. 5 Espoir, No. 6 Hope, No. 7
Space, No. 8 Esperanza, No. 9 Speranza and No. 10
Nadezhda, all located in the L4 area.

A special operations unit under the direct command of the
<Earth Federation Government>'s President, formed after
the <Shura Revolt>. An armed organization outside the
<Earth Federation Army>'s jurisdiction, it was to be granted
the "PGS (The privilege of the GAIA SABERS)." The PGS,
also called "GS Privilege," is a special right to swiftly
carry out the President's special orders on military
matters. It also allows the formation of an armed
organization separate from the <Federation Army>, and is
the right to refuse any order or instruction from the
military.
Its base was <Grand Christmas>, and it held many
high-performance humanoid mobile weapons (including
units the Gaia Savers developed themselves). Like the
<Steel Dragons>, it was built around ISA tactics (blitzkrieg
using mobile battleships serving as carriers and the
humanoid mobile weapons aboard them).
Its commander was Special Vice President Arteur
Steinbeck, whose schemes framed the Steel Dragons for
the assassination of President Graien Grassman, and the
Gaia Savers hunted them.
The Steel Dragons then received support and requests
from those who saw Arteur and the Gaia Savers as
dangerous, and stormed Grand Christmas. After a fierce
battle, they defeated the Gaia Savers. The key members
were killed, the surviving personnel were arrested after
<The Sealing War>, and the organization was destroyed.

The <Earth Federation Army> Far East Command 1st

strings.en:
The military formed in <S.C.> 184 by reorganizing the Earth
Federation Space Force stationed in the colonies, when
the 10 space colonies united into an independent nation.
Nominally a separate organization, it could in fact be
called part of the <Federation Army> (some United Colony
Corps officers resent this). Because it must carry out
advanced space operations and combat, it has many
talented personnel.
At the end of S.C. 186, it declared war on the Federation
government and Federation Army alongside the <DC>. Since
most space forces at the time were United Colony Corps,
it quickly won control of space.
It then supported DC operations on the ground, but
surrendered to the Federation Army after its supreme
commander, Maier V. Branstein, was killed in action. That,
however, was to prepare for the coming decisive battle
with the aliens, and indeed many United Colony Corps units
took part in "<Operation SRW>," the final operation of the
<L5 Campaign>.
After the war, it came under Federation Army jurisdiction
and its leadership was replaced, leaving its name an empty
shell, but it still makes up most of the forces in space.

To board the G-Compatible Kaiser, Kota and Shoko must

The G-Compatible Kaiser's base lies beneath Asakusa in
Tokyo, and in an emergency the unit sorties from the

strings.en:
Shura Gods are weapons used by the <Shura>, powered by
the bio-energy of their masters.
They come in ranks such as "Retsu-class," "Goh-class"
and "Choh-class," and any Shura with a certain level of
fighting spirit (life energy) and skill can pilot a
lowest-rank Retsu-class Shura God.
Goh- and Choh-class Shura Gods, however, are more
selective about their riders, and becoming their master
requires due strength, trials and rituals. Once a master
is chosen, it is basically impossible for anyone else to
board and operate it until that master dies. One theory
says Goh- and Choh-class Shura Gods have something
like a will, and only let those they have accepted as their
master board them (if an unfit person boards, the Shura
God drains their fighting spirit dry and they die).
Shura Gods of Goh-class and above were made with lost
technology, and today's Shura cannot develop new ones.
So Goh- and Choh-class Shura Gods are limited in
number, and some have been in use for hundreds of
years. There also seem to be several Shura Gods sealed
away because no master has been found for them.
Masters of Goh-class Shura Gods are held in high regard
among the Shura and have a certain authority. Becoming
the master of a Choh-class Shura God is a prerequisite
for the rank of Shura general.
Retsu-class Shura Gods were made by studying the
surviving Goh-class Shura Gods; their performance is
greatly reduced, but they can be mass-produced.

The war waged by the "<Shura>," a band of warriors that
crossed into the Earth Sphere from another world, the
"Shura realm." With the Shura realm on the brink of
destruction, Alkaid, king of "Ra," one of its nations, led
the Shura into the "Tenku Majo" (Earth's code name:
Swordian), a giant sword-shaped structure capable of
dimensional transfer, and made the jump in search of a new
land. They arrived in the Earth Sphere after the
<Inspector Incident> and invaded many parts of Earth with
mobile weapons called <Shura God>s. Several cities fell to
the Shura, but the Hagane and Hiryu Custom's forces
launched "<Operation Overgate>," a raid into the Tenku
Majo. Together with Folka Albark and others, who had
come to question the Shura way of life and sided with
Earth, they succeeded in defeating Alkaid.
After the war ended, Folka and the surviving Shura made a
dimensional jump in the Tenku Majo and left the Earth
Sphere.

strings.en:
A man-machine interface installed in Josh's and Rim's
units. Only those who succeed in First Contact can use it.
It can also create a psychic link with the pilots of other
units carrying the same system. Glacies's Fabularis carries
a similar system.
Sympathia was found in the ruins of <Fabula Foresse> under
the Antarctic ice, and <Perfectio> called it "a distorted key."
The "key" he spoke of was a sensor for studying the
source of the negative waves that feed him... that is, the
knowledge and state of mind of intelligent life, as well as a
booby trap for creating the armies of ruin that serve as
his vanguard.
But the "key" obtained by the <Re-Tech>, Sympathia, had
been modified or copied by those who built Fabula Foresse.
Even so, it still functions as a "key" to some degree, and it
is said that long use of Sympathia eats away at the soul
and may transform the user into something close to the
<Meliores Esse>.
However, Sympathia has the property of binding and
resonating people's thoughts (for better or worse), and in
the final battle with the <Ruina>, Josh and Rim drew on the
strength of their comrades fighting alongside them to
push Perfectio's temporary mechanical body back into the
<Cross Gate>.
Josh then tried to use Sympathia to stop Perfectio's true
body from emerging, but <Chris> and Ventus, a Meliores
Esse, took his place.

strings.en:
A training institution for humanoid mobile weapon pilots
that once existed within the <Federation Army>. It was
founded at almost the same time as the
<Special Tactics Instructor Unit>.
At first, it retrained pilots of existing weapons to fly
humanoid mobile weapons such as <Personal Trooper>s, but
its goals changed completely after Adler Koch took charge
of the School.
Rather than retraining pilots of existing weapons, he
sought to train pilots meant to fly humanoid mobile
weapons from the very start.
To that end, he secretly gathered children with no family
ties and excellent reflexes and dynamic vision. He also
brought in Dr. Aguila Setome from the Japan Special Brain
Medicine Institute to erase and manipulate the children's
memories. Adler then subjected them to mind control and
drugs and gave them special training. He was trying to
create, "in a short time," humans with abilities specialized
for piloting and fighting in humanoid mobile weapons...
"<Boosted Children>."
The children were divided into classes named after metals,
such as Aurum (gold), Argent (silver), Bronzo (bronze),
Hierro (iron) and Latune (brass), and were conditioned for
various purposes.
But perhaps because of the forceful methods, only a
handful of children ever achieved outstanding results.
The inhumane training methods and the poor results they
produced became an issue, and the School was disbanded.
However, the training of Boosted Children continued after
moving to the <DC>.

Teiniquet Zezenan. A member of the <Zovorg>'s Zogal
faction and supreme commander of the <Guest>.
He is arrogant, self-confident and calculating, and skilled
at using his power to win people over. He treats Earthlings
with extreme prejudice. He had taken an interest in Earth
since before the <DC War> and was interfering and
negotiating behind the scenes (he was even present at the
<Antarctic Incident>).
During <The Sealing War>, with the backing of <Golaikunru>, he
led his forces in a campaign to conquer Earth. He planned
to seize the Earth Sphere, obtain the military technology
Earthlings had developed on their own and the technology
brought from other worlds, and use them as achievements
to expand his power in the Zovorg homeland. In the end,
however, he was defeated by the <Steel Dragons> and killed

strings.en:
A great alien power located in a region of space far from
the solar system: an interstellar republican union. Its
highest decision-making body is called the "<Privy Council>."
In the name of keeping order in the galaxy, it audits
undeveloped alien civilizations outside the union, and if it
judges them dangerous, it uses various means to bring
them under its control.
It had been secretly watching Earth since before the
<DC War>, and judged that Earthlings, with their insatiable
fighting spirit and remarkable ability to apply military
technology, were a race whose intellect and power were
out of balance and would eventually disrupt the order of
the galaxy. It began to interfere, but the agendas and
power struggles of its two great factions, Zogal and
Volga, kept it from acting in step, and its two armed
invasions of Earth both failed.
After <The Sealing War>, the Privy Council decided to take a
stance of non-intervention toward Earth rather than
conclude a treaty. Mekibos Borgue, formerly a member of
the <Inspectors> (Volga faction), is stationed on Earth as
the Privy Council's envoy and serves as the liaison with the
Zovorg.

weapons compatible with the <Universal Connector> standard.
<EOT> made real what were thought to be fantasy weapons in
the Old Calendar era, but Daniel Instruments deliberately
focused on adapting the fruits of conventional technology to
the Universal Connector standard. Its weapons are prized by
pilots and mechanics in the field for their reliable

strings.en:
Tactical Cybernetics Operating System (a tactical,
motion-reasoning OS).
The OS of <Personal Trooper>s and other humanoid mobile
weapons. For example, if the pilot chooses the action
"punch the enemy," it calculates the current positions of
its own unit and the enemy, and the AI selects the most
efficient and appropriate motion from the multiple motion
pattern data sets stored in the unit.
This frees the pilot from the complex operation of a
humanoid mobile weapon; the pilot only needs to judge the
situation and give minimal input, and the unit itself
automatically selects the right motion and carries out the
action the pilot intended.
The pilot can also freely set the types of motion pattern
data and their execution priority, so the unit's movements
can be optimized to suit the pilot's preferences and
piloting habits.

It extracts the "T-Alpha Pulse," a special deep brainwave
that governs human thought, and uses it to control the
motion of objects, assist in piloting mobile weapons and
more.
It can also generate a force field called a TK Field, which
can be deployed as a barrier, or slammed into enemy units
to damage them.
Amplifying thought also extends the user's special
perception (a sixth sense close to touch) over a wide area,
making it possible to some extent to lock onto enemies
and grasp their positions.
However, the system's function depends on the user's
state of mind, and excessive linking places a heavy strain
on the brain.
In Kenzou's project, people from whom a T-Alpha Pulse
above a certain level is detected are called "<Telekinetic>s."

strings.en:
A military society founded by <Dr. Bian Zoldark>, who
foresaw an alien invasion, using the <EOTI Institute> as its
parent body.
Its goal was to establish a powerful military regime over
the Earth Sphere in order to resist the aliens scheming to
invade Earth.
Besides EOTI Institute members, it was joined by
Federation government staff, some <Federation Army>
soldiers, anti-Federation activists and fighters from
national liberation fronts, and the <United Colony Corps>
also offered its cooperation.
At the end of <S.C.> 186, it rose in revolt against the
<Earth Federation Government> and the Federation Army,
and succeeded in seizing military bases across the Earth
Sphere in a blitz using <Armored Module>s.
But the methods chosen by Bian and Maier V. Branstein,
supreme commander of the United Colony Corps, were a
double-edged sword.
By becoming the "enemy" themselves, they meant to give
humanity a simulated sense of the situation it faced and
quickly stir up the will to stand against an unprecedented
threat, but a prolonged civil war carried a high risk of
exhausting Earth's own fighting strength.
So, while hoping for a quick end to the <DC War>, they had no
choice but to preserve the enemy's (the Federation
Army's) strength to some degree. Bian also intended,
should people strong enough to defeat him appear, to
entrust them with the future of the Earth Sphere.
It could be said that this contradictory thinking invited
Bian's own defeat, and let those who used the <DC> for
selfish ends grow bolder.
Bian was killed in the Hagane's surprise attack on the DC
headquarters. Without him, the DC fell into disarray and
was defeated by the Federation Army.

A high-efficiency reaction thruster developed at the
<Tesla Reich Institute>.
It can change gravitational mass (weight) and inertial mass
(resistance to motion) separately, and uses this to
accelerate conventional propellant and propel objects
efficiently. It could be called a kind of gravity control
device.
It makes flight within the atmosphere and space travel
easy, but early devices were so large that only
warship-class vessels could carry them. However, analysis
of the <EOT> from <Meteor 3> brought great advances in the
physics of gravity control, and the Tesla Drive itself
became far more powerful and compact.
Starting with the <Armored Module>s developed by the <DC>, it
could then be installed in 20-meter-class humanoid mobile
weapons.

A substance discovered in <Meteor 3>.

A metallic substance the size of a grain of rice, it holds a
vast amount of energy. Meteor 3 contained 6 pieces of
Tronium, which were analyzed and studied by the
<EOTI Institute>. Some of them were provided to the
<Federation Army> through various deals (in which Major
<Ingram Plissken> of the <SRX Project> was involved).
The Tronium Engine is a power plant that extracts Tronium's
virtually limitless energy and converts it into power; its
energy conversion per unit of time is too great to measure.
Because the engine materials possible with humanity's level
of technology cannot withstand the high energy generated, a
limiter is fitted. Raising its output also increases energy
generation at an accelerating rate, making output control
extremely difficult.

A rebellion at the <Earth Federation Army>'s <Coatsland Base>
in Antarctica in <S.C.> 186.
At the time, the base was holding an unveiling ceremony
for the Shirogane, first ship of the state-of-the-art
Space Noah-class multipurpose battleships, and the
Granzon, a humanoid mobile weapon developed by the
<EOTI Institute>. But this was a cover; behind the scenes,
peace talks were underway with extraterrestrial
intelligent life code-named the "<Guest>."
However, the terms amounted to Earth's near-total
surrender to the Guest, and quite a few of those who knew
the truth were outraged.
During the talks, Dr. Shu Shirakawa, one of the Granzon's
developers and its test pilot, suddenly attacked the
Guest's spacecraft. He then turned his fangs on the
<Federation Army> as well, and Coatsland Base was left in
ruins.
This incident broke off negotiations with the Guest. The
<DC> rose up right afterward, and the incident triggered the
wars that followed (the <DC War>, the <L5 Campaign> and the
<Inspector Incident>).
Before the talks, the Guest had appeared over Coatsland
Base aboard an <Aerogators> spacecraft, so at the time of
the incident many people thought the Guest and the
Aerogators were the same.
But now, after the Inspector Incident and <The Sealing War>,
it has become clear that the Guest used a disguised ship,
and that they were not Aerogators but a faction (Zogal)
of the <Zovorg>.

strings.en:
The leader of the <Divine Crusaders>, the military society
that rose in revolt against the
<Earth Federation Government> and <Earth Federation Army>
at the end of <S.C.> 186. A genius robotics scientist. A
realist who would use any means to reach his goals, and at
the same time an idealist with a romantic side. He
combined reason and emotion and had great charisma.
Having foreseen an alien invasion of Earth even before
<Meteor 3> fell, Bian poured his personal fortune into
founding the <Tesla Reich Institute>. After Meteor 3 fell, he
became head of the <EOTI Institute>, which analyzed the
<EOT> found in it. He then formed the <DC> with that institute
as its parent body and declared war on the whole world. He
was killed in the <Battle of Aidoneus Island> in S.C. 187.

strings.en:
The war against aliens and hostile beings from other
worlds that broke out after the <Shura Revolt>.
After forces sent by the <Zovorg>, a great alien power,
began invading Earth, a horde of hostile beings called the
<Ruina> emerged from the ruins of <Fabula Foresse> under the
Antarctic ice and attacked a city in South America. While
the <Earth Federation Army> fought back, the <Steel Dragons>
fell into a trap set by Arteur Steinbeck, a central figure of
the <Gaia Savers>, and were framed for the assassination of
the President of the <Earth Federation Government>.
Right after that, the Ruina created a dimensional fault
(the <Atrum Exterior>), cutting Earth off from the outside
world. This slowed the Zovorg forces, and the war fell into
a stalemate.
On the darkened surface, the Steel Dragons, while pursued
by the Earth Federation Army, succeeded in eliminating
the dimensional fault. Then, with the support and at the
request of those who saw Arteur and the Gaia Savers as
dangerous, they stormed <Grand Christmas> and, after a
fierce battle, defeated the Gaia Savers.
Meanwhile, the Earth Federation Army launched a
counteroffensive against the Zovorg forces (Operation
Reconquista) and an operation to wipe out the Ruina
(Operation Icebreaker). The Steel Dragons took part in
both and led them to success. During the final battle with
the Ruina, a <Cross Gate> was discovered in the depths of
Fabula Foresse.
Then <Baral>, which worships <Gan Eden> as a god and has
worked behind the scenes since ancient times, deployed a
powerful barrier and sealed off Earth. Gan Eden, calling
itself the guardian of the mother planet, deemed those
living beyond Earth outside its protection and declared it
would exterminate them.
The Steel Dragons challenged Baral and Gan Eden to stop
this and won. But then Arteur Steinbeck, who should have
been dead, appeared and fused Gan Eden with the Cross
Gate, becoming the new man-made god <Adamatron>. After
a fierce battle, the Steel Dragons succeeded in defeating
this final enemy.
Because Earth was sealed off twice, these battles were
named "The Sealing War."

strings.en:
During <The Sealing War>, when Earth was covered by the
<Ruina's Dimensional Rift>, the sun, moon and stars all
vanished from the sky. Travel and communication
between Earth and space also became impossible.
The world fell into endless night, and as temperatures
dropped, lighting and heating were used all at once
worldwide, and the excess power demand nearly
overloaded the power lines. The loss of sunlight also
unsettled people's minds, causing panic.
The dimensional fault vanished thanks to the
<Steel Dragons>, but had the Black Sky continued, it would
have greatly affected atmospheric circulation and
ocean currents, and would very likely have led to a
Snowball Earth (global freezing).

strings.en:
A giant spherical space fortress used by the <Aerogators>
as their base in the <L5 Campaign>. Its official name is the
"Automated Planet Neviim"; White Star is Earth's code
name for it.
Inside are mobile weapon plants, a spaceport, 1G living
areas with simulated weather, multiple farms and more, so
it could be called a mobile space colony. One theory holds
that it was built to carry large numbers of Earthlings with
strong fighting spirit and combat ability back to the
Aerogators' home planet, but this is uncertain.
Near the end of the L5 Campaign, it was heavily damaged
and stopped functioning under the all-out attack of
Earth's allied space fleet in <Operation SRW>. After the war,
it was placed under <Earth Federation Army> jurisdiction.
However, it was seized by the <Inspectors>, aliens who
invaded the Earth Sphere in <S.C.> 187, and became their
base. Later, it fused with the Neu Regisseur, leader of the
<Einst>, and was transformed into the colossal weapon Stern
Neu Regisseur. It warped into another dimension with the
Kurogane and Hiryu Custom, and after a fierce battle with
them, it was destroyed.

strings.en:
Short for "Re-Mind Control."
Originally, adjusting the memories and controlling the minds
of those who have undergone memory manipulation or special
suggestion (such as the <Boosted Children>) according to their
mission. However, excessive rewriting of memories raises
the risk of a mental breakdown. Implanting completely
different concepts or memories is also dangerous, so related
information is usually rewritten gradually. Boosted Children
in particular tend to show abilities beyond their specs when
Remote Controlled with emotions such as love, friendship,
hostility or grudges as the key.

strings.en:
A horde of hostile beings that emerged early in
<The Sealing War> from the ruins of <Fabula Foresse>
discovered in Antarctica (from the <Cross Gate> inside it).
Also called "the Armies of Ruin."
Their goal was to bring about the advent of the "King of
Ruin," <Perfectio>, and they gathered the negative emotions
of intelligent life (fear, agony, despair, hatred and so on)
that feed him.
They tried to achieve their goal by shrouding Earth in
darkness with the <Atrum Exterior> and driving many people
to despair at once, but were thwarted by the
<Steel Dragons>.
They were later wiped out under the Steel Dragons' fierce
assault during "Operation Icebreaker," the
<Earth Federation Army>'s operation to capture Fabula
Foresse.

strings.en:
ReEOTH PLAN.
ReEOTH (Reios) stands for "Reliable Extra Over
Technological Hybrid," meaning "a highly reliable alien
technology complex."
A plan to fundamentally reexamine the unstable <EOT> and
raise its reliability and stability by introducing Earth's
latest technology.
It aims not only to improve the performance of existing
EOT-equipped units, but eventually to bring ReEOTH to
the R Series' successors and future mass-production
units.
